metadata.title: Moida Mansion LCD Asset & Display Mapping
metadata.author: Lucas Pope (dukope)

engine_architecture.hardware_target: Retro Handheld Console (e.g., R36S, Anbernic, Miyoo)

bitset_memory_layout.description: The display state is a 631-bit bitfield (spriteState) stored across 20 32-bit integers (Int32Array[20]).
bitset_memory_layout.lookup_logic: word_index = Math.trunc(segment_index / 32); bit_offset = segment_index % 32; is_on = (data[word_index] & (1 << bit_offset)) !== 0;

sound_model.description: Square wave / piezoelectric beeper sound simulation with variable frequency (Hz) and duration (ms).

lcd_textline.description: 13-character multi-segment LCD alphanumeric text display used for room names, dialog, numbers, and stats.

digit_font_mapping.description: Maps numeric digits 0 through 9 to their respective font character code in romData.fontChars.

stat_counters.description: Game stats displayed on the LCD text line after finishing or escaping the mansion.

hud_map_and_input_controls.description: Mini-map and directional input status indicators displayed around the LCD panel.

mansion_walls_and_borders.description: Fixed structural walls, floors, and room perimeter segments defining the mansion architecture.
mansion_walls_and_borders.name: ICN_walls

screen_wipe_boundary.description: Full-screen LCD wipe boundary covering all active display segments.
screen_wipe_boundary.name: ICN_all_sprites_wipe

doors_and_exits.description: Doorways, locks, gates, and passage tunnels connecting suites and floors.

hero.description: Main player / investigator character walking, climbing stairs, and searching rooms in Moida Mansion.

monsta_and_ghost.description: The terrifying Monster (Monsta) prowling the corridors and the ghostly phantoms in the mansion.

friends.description: The three friends trapped inside Moida Mansion that the player must find and rescue.

fairy.description: Magical helper fairy providing hints and codes.

spider.description: Spider companion / secret found in rooms.
spider.name: ICN_escape_spider

boxes_and_containers.description: Chests, drawers, cabinets, and wardrobes in each room that can be searched for keys, items, or friends.

lighting.description: Chandeliers and lamps that can flicker when ghosts or monsters approach.
